title: Total Value of Festive Grant for 2023 Contributed by Lee Foundation and Disbursed to ComCare Recipients
what_it_is: Total Value of Festive Grant for 2023 Contributed by Lee Foundation and Disbursed to ComCare Recipients

sections.label: Festive grants disbursement
sections.summary: In 2023 about $82,000 was disbursed to about 680 persons, and Hong Leong Foundation and Shaw Foundation disburse CNY festive grants to ComCare Long-Term beneficiaries, averaging about $960,000 yearly over five years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In 2023, they disbursed about $82,000 to about 680 of such persons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The Hong Leong Foundation and Shaw Foundation also disburse CNY festive grants annually to ComCare Long-Term beneficiaries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: They averaged about $960,000 per year over the past five years.

sections.label: 2023 referrals of 680 persons
sections.summary: For 2023, 680 persons who did not qualify for ComCare were referred.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: For 2023, 680 of such persons who did not qualify for ComCare and they were referred to – all of them, yes, the 680.
